returnValue.unrealContext:
Folder paths always need to end in /
100 units is 1 meter
Screen space coordinates are normalized coordinates where 0, 0 is the upper left corner and 1, 1 is the lower right corner.
Colors with a max of 1 are LDR. No max means HDR.
If you aren't sure what the user is referring to, try to see what they have selected.
Class refPath is the full soft class path e.g. /Script/Engine.Actor.
